articles.title: Compact Enough Phone gets three upgrades without a price increase
articles.description: The Enough Phone is as small as an Apple iPhone 13 Mini, yet aims to stand out with a replaceable battery, a modern 50 MP main camera, and Android 17. The manufacturer is now giving the smartphone several significant upgrades just before the end of its crowdfunding campaign, which has yet to reach its goal.

articles.title: Structural agility of 2D crystals enables digital doping of graphene superlattices
articles.description: A study published in Nature has demonstrated that applying an electric field can switch the atomic arrangement in a stack of two-dimensional (2D) crystals, accompanied by an unusual charge behavior. This provides a new experimental platform for exploring how the structural and electronic properties of atomically thin materials interact.

articles.title: Chip-scale narrow-linewidth optical parametric oscillators
articles.description: Continuous-wave-pumped optical parametric oscillators (OPOs) provide an exciting avenue to generate coherent radiation at wavelength regions that are difficult to reach by traditional semiconductor optical amplifiers. However, attaining ultra-narrow linewidth operation in OPOs requires pump lasers with exceptional purity to begin with. Here, we demonstrate an integrated Kerr nonlinear OPO featuring an integrated external cavity based on ultralow-loss silicon nitride that results in a continuous-wave signal with a 15-fold intrinsic linewidth reduction compared to the pump, down to 10 Hz. Our numerical analysis indicates that the intrinsic linewidth can be reduced below the Schawlow-Townes limit of a single-cavity OPO depending on the feedback length and strength of the external cavity. Utilizing an integrated erbium-doped waveguide amplifier, we further demonstrate sub-Hz intrinsic linewidth coherent oscillation. These results establish an effective pathway towards chip-scale ultra-coherent light sources with high power and broad wavelength tunability, opening new opportunities for high-precision optical sensing and detection. Continuous-wave optical parametric oscillators can generate coherent light at wavelengths beyond semiconductor lasers, but narrow linewidth needs pure pump lasers. Here, authors couple a Kerr OPO to an ultralow-loss silicon nitride cavity, narrowing linewidth 15-fold to 10 Hz, enabling chip-scale, high-power, tunable, ultra-stable sources.
